                    <h2 class="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 leading-tight">
                        Bridging Laboratory Chemical Precision with On-Field Farm Conditions
                    </h2>
                    <p class="text-slate-600 leading-relaxed text-base">
                        <strong class="text-slate-900">Stellix Agri Science</strong> is an Ahmedabad-based agrochemical manufacturing and crop protection enterprise dedicated to revolutionizing Indian agriculture through precision chemical formulations and sustainable agronomic solutions. Operating from our manufacturing base in <strong class="text-slate-900">Aslali, Ahmedabad</strong>, we formulate, test, and package an extensive portfolio of high-efficacy Insecticides, Selective Herbicides, Systemic Fungicides, Bio-Pesticides, and Advanced Plant Growth Regulators (PGR). Every formulation is engineered to address field challenges—from aggressive sucking pest complexes and stubborn perennial weeds to fungal blights—ensuring farmers achieve resilient crop health and superior yields.
                    </p>
                    <p class="text-slate-600 leading-relaxed text-base">
                        At the core of Stellix Agri Science is an uncompromising <strong class="text-green-700">Farmer-First Philosophy</strong>. We recognize that modern agriculture requires targeted efficacy without causing environmental degradation or secondary pest resistance. Our state-of-the-art facility integrates dedicated herbicide isolation suites to prevent cross-contamination, automated liquid and powder processing lines, and strict ecological compliance aligned with the <strong class="text-slate-900">Insecticides Act, 1968</strong> and <strong class="text-slate-900">CIB&amp;RC statutory guidelines</strong>. By bridging laboratory chemical precision with actual on-field farm conditions, we deliver cost-effective, dependable inputs that protect our growers' investments season after season.
                    </p>
                    <p class="text-slate-600 leading-relaxed text-base">
                        Through strategic distributor partnerships across Gujarat and neighboring agricultural belts, Stellix Agri Science provides direct factory billing, responsive logistics, and comprehensive field technical guidance. We are not merely agrochemical suppliers; we are committed agronomic thought partners to dealers, distributors, and farmers, driving progressive and commercially profitable agriculture.
                    </p>

    <script>
        let activeProductIdForUpload = null;

        // Exact Official Logo Handler (No Fake/Altered Logo - Uses ONLY user's exact uploaded image)
        function handleLogoFallback(imgElement) {
            if (!imgElement.dataset.triedLogoJpg) {
                imgElement.dataset.triedLogoJpg = "true";
                imgElement.src = "logo.jpg";
            } else {
                imgElement.style.display = "none";
            }
        }

        function applyOfficialLogoEverywhere(dataUrl) {
            const headerLogo = document.getElementById('headerBrandLogo');
            const heroLogo = document.getElementById('heroBrandLogo');
            const footerLogo = document.getElementById('footerBrandLogo');
            const heroPrompt = document.getElementById('heroLogoPrompt');
            const setLogoBtnText = document.getElementById('setLogoBtnText');

            if (headerLogo) {
                headerLogo.src = dataUrl;
                headerLogo.style.display = 'block';
            }
            if (heroLogo) {
                heroLogo.src = dataUrl;
                heroLogo.style.display = 'block';
            }
            if (footerLogo) {
                footerLogo.src = dataUrl;
                footerLogo.style.display = 'block';
            }
            if (heroPrompt) {
                heroPrompt.style.display = 'none';
            }
            if (setLogoBtnText) {
                setLogoBtnText.textContent = 'Change Logo Photo';
            }
        }

        function uploadOfficialLogo(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(e) {
                const result = e.target.result;
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('stellix_exact_official_logo', result);
                } catch (err) {}
                applyOfficialLogoEverywhere(result);
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        }

                packType: "pouch",
                crops: "All crops, root stimulation, soil aeration, nutrient uptake",
                cropsGuj: "બધા પાકોમાં મૂળનો વિકાસ અને જમીનની ફળદ્રુપતા વધારવા",
                dosage: "500g - 1kg per acre soil application (૫૦૦ ગ્રામ થી ૧ કિલો પ્રતિ એકર જમીનમાં આપવું)",
                packs: "250g, 500g, 1kg, 5kg, 25kg",
                advantages: "Highly concentrated 95% organic humic extract. Stimulates extensive lateral root development, improves soil CEC, and increases drought resistance.",
                image: ""
            }
        ];

        let currentCategory = 'ALL';

        function getCategoryBadgeStyle(cat) {
            switch(cat) {
                case 'INSECTICIDE': return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-200';
                case 'HERBICIDE': return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200';
                case 'FUNGICIDE': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200';
                case 'SPECIALTY': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border-purple-200';
                default: return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800';
            }
        }

        function renderProducts() {
            const searchQuery = document.getElementById('productSearch').value.toLowerCase();
            const grid = document.getElementById('productsGrid');
            
            const filtered = products.filter(p => {
                const matchesCat = currentCategory === 'ALL' || p.category === currentCategory;
                const matchesSearch = p.tradeName.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery) ||
                                      p.gujName.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery) ||
                                      p.technical.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery) ||
                                      p.crops.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery);
                return matchesCat && matchesSearch;
            });

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                grid.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="col-span-full text-center py-12 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-box-open text-4xl text-slate-400 mb-3"></i>
                        <p class="font-bold text-slate-700">No matching products found.</p>
                        <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Try clearing your search filter.</p>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(p => {
                const savedImg = localStorage.getItem('stellix_img_' + p.id) || p.image;
                const badgeClass = getCategoryBadgeStyle(p.category);
                
                const visualSection = savedImg ? `
                    <img src="${savedImg}" alt="${p.tradeName}" class="w-full h-full object-contain p-4">
                ` : `
                    <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-4">
                        <div class="w-20 h-24 rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-md border border-slate-200 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 mb-2 relative">
                            <span class="text-[9px] font-extrabold tracking-widest text-green-700 uppercase">STELLIX</span>
                            <i class="fa-solid ${p.packType === 'bottle' ? 'fa-bottle-droplet text-green-600' : 'fa-bag-shopping text-amber-600'} text-3xl my-1.5"></i>
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-800 line-clamp-1">${p.tradeName.split('/')[0]}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-medium">Product Photo Pending</span>
                    </div>
                `;

                const whatsappMsg = encodeURIComponent(`Hello Stellix Agri Science, I want to inquire about *${p.tradeName}* (${p.technical}). Please share details and pricing.`);

                return `
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between card-hover">
                        <div>
                            <!-- Product Image / Smart Placeholder Header -->
                            <div class="h-48 bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50 to-slate-100/70 border-b border-slate-100 relative flex items-center justify-center group">
                                <span class="absolute top-3 left-3 text-[11px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border ${badgeClass}">
                                    ${p.catLabel}
                                </span>
                                <button onclick="triggerPhotoUpload('${p.id}')" title="Test/Add Product Photo"
                                        class="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-white/90 hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 text-[11px] font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1 transition">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i>
                                    <span>${savedImg ? 'Change Photo' : 'Add Photo'}</span>
                                </button>
                                ${visualSection}
                            </div>

                            <!-- Card Body -->
                            <div class="p-6">
                                <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2 mb-1">
                                    <h3 class="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">${p.tradeName}</h3>
                                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-green-700 font-gujarati">${p.gujName}</span>
                                </div>

                                <div class="bg-slate-50 rounded-xl p-3 border border-slate-200/70 mb-4">
                                    <p class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">${p.technical}</p>
                                    <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-gujarati mt-0.5">${p.techGuj} • <span class="font-sans text-slate-600 font-medium">${p.formulation}</span></p>
                                </div>

                                <div class="space-y-2.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
                                    <div>
                                        <strong class="text-slate-900 block mb-0.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-leaf text-green-600 mr-1"></i> Target Crops & Pests:</strong>
                                        <p>${p.crops}</p>
                                        <p class="font-gujarati text-slate-500 mt-0.5">${p.cropsGuj}</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <strong class="text-slate-900 block mb-0.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-prescription-bottle text-amber-600 mr-1"></i> Dosage:</strong>
                                        <p>${p.dosage}</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <strong class="text-slate-900 block mb-0.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-boxes-stacked text-blue-600 mr-1"></i> Available Pack Sizes:</strong>
                                        <p class="font-semibold text-slate-800">${p.packs}</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="pt-1">
                                        <strong class="text-slate-900 block mb-0.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-star text-amber-500 mr-1"></i> Key Advantages:</strong>
                                        <p class="leading-relaxed text-slate-600">${p.advantages}</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Card Footer CTA -->
                        <div class="px-6 pb-5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                            <a href="https://wa.me/919327568738?text=${whatsappMsg}" target="_blank"
                               class="w-full bg-green-50 hover:bg-green-700 text-green-800 hover:text-white border border-green-200 font-bold py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-sm"></i>
                                <span>Inquire / Order on WhatsApp</span>
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        function filterProducts(cat) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            document.querySelectorAll('.cat-btn').forEach(btn => {
                if (btn.getAttribute('data-cat') === cat) {
                    btn.className = 'cat-btn bg-green-700 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm transition shadow-sm';
                } else {
                    btn.className = 'cat-btn bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm transition';
                }
            });
            renderProducts();
        }

        // Photo Upload Preview Handler (Saves in browser localStorage for instant preview)
        function triggerPhotoUpload(productId) {
            activeProductIdForUpload = productId;
            document.getElementById('photoUploader').click();
        }

        function handlePhotoUpload(event) {
            const file = event.target.files[0];
            if (!file || !activeProductIdForUpload) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(e) {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('stellix_img_' + activeProductIdForUpload, e.target.result);
                } catch (err) {
                    const prod = products.find(item => item.id === activeProductIdForUpload);
                    if (prod) prod.image = e.target.result;
                }
                renderProducts();
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        }

        // Direct WhatsApp Form Handler
        function sendWhatsAppInquiry(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            const name = document.getElementById('inqName').value;
            const phone = document.getElementById('inqPhone').value;
            const city = document.getElementById('inqCity').value;
            const type = document.getElementById('inqType').value;
            const msg = document.getElementById('inqMsg').value;

            const text = `*New Website Inquiry - Stellix Agri Science*%0A%0A` +
                         `*Name/Firm:* ${encodeURIComponent(name)}%0A` +
                         `*Phone:* ${encodeURIComponent(phone)}%0A` +
                         `*City/District:* ${encodeURIComponent(city)}%0A` +
                         `*Inquiry Type:* ${encodeURIComponent(type)}%0A` +
                         `*Message:* ${encodeURIComponent(msg || 'N/A')}`;

            window.open(`https://wa.me/919327568738?text=${text}`, '_blank');
        }

        // Load Saved Official Logo & Products on Startup
        document.getElementById('productSearch').addEventListener('input', renderProducts);
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const savedOfficialLogo = localStorage.getItem('stellix_exact_official_logo');
            if (savedOfficialLogo) {
                applyOfficialLogoEverywhere(savedOfficialLogo);
            }
            renderProducts();
        });
    </script>

</body></html>
